segments.name: Retail net lease
segments.description: Acquires, owns and manages single-tenant commercial retail properties on long-term net leases to high-credit-quality tenants across the United States.
segments.evidence: The Company aggregates these investments for reporting purposes and operates in one reportable segment.

revenueModel.text: Tenants pay the company rent under long-term net leases and are obligated to pay property operating costs.
revenueModel.evidence: The Company acquires, owns, and manages single-tenant commercial retail net lease properties, the majority of which have long-term triple-net leases where the tenant is generally responsible for all improvements and contractually obligated to pay all operating costs (such as real estate taxes, utilities, and repairs and maintenance costs).
